entries.title: Psalms 81:1
segments: ¶<<To the Chief Musician. On an instrument of Gath. A Psalm of Asaph.>> Sing aloud to God our strength; Make a joyful shout to the God of Jacob.

entries.title: Psalms 81:2
segments: Raise a song and strike the timbrel, The pleasant harp with the lute.

entries.title: Psalms 81:3
segments: Blow the trumpet at the time of the New Moon, At the full moon, on our solemn feast day.

entries.title: Psalms 81:4
segments: For this [is] a statute for Israel, A law of the God of Jacob.

entries.title: Psalms 81:5
segments: This He established in Joseph [as] a testimony, When He went throughout the land of Egypt, [Where] I heard a language I did not understand.

entries.title: Psalms 81:6
segments: "I removed his shoulder from the burden; His hands were freed from the baskets.

entries.title: Psalms 81:7
segments: You called in trouble, and I delivered you; I answered you in the secret place of thunder; I tested you at the waters of Meribah. Selah

entries.title: Psalms 81:8
segments: ¶"Hear, O My people, and I will admonish you! O Israel, if you will listen to Me!

entries.title: Psalms 81:9
segments: There shall be no foreign god among you; Nor shall you worship any foreign god.

entries.title: Psalms 81:10
segments: I [am] the LORD your God, Who brought you out of the land of Egypt; Open your mouth wide, and I will fill it.

entries.title: Psalms 81:11
segments: "But My people would not heed My voice, And Israel would [have] none of Me.

entries.title: Psalms 81:12
segments: So I gave them over to their own stubborn heart, To walk in their own counsels.

entries.title: Psalms 81:13
segments: "Oh, that My people would listen to Me, That Israel would walk in My ways!

entries.title: Psalms 81:14
segments: I would soon subdue their enemies, And turn My hand against their adversaries.

entries.title: Psalms 81:15
segments: The haters of the LORD would pretend submission to Him, But their fate would endure forever.

entries.title: Psalms 81:16
segments: He would have fed them also with the finest of wheat; And with honey from the rock I would have satisfied you."
